 Hon'Ble Sandeep Jain, J. 
Order on Cross Objection No.3 of 2024
1.

Sri S.K. Mishra, learned counsel for the cross objector and Sri Shivam Yadav counsel for Noida
alongwith Standing Counsel for the State are present.

2.  This cross objection has been filed in First Appeal No.320 of 2006 (NOIDA vs. State of U.P. and others) for enhancement of compensation awarded in L.A.R. No.414 of 1991 (Virendra Singh and others vs. State of U.P. and another), by award and decree dated 13.05.2002 by Sri R.A. Kaushik,
IXth Additional District Judge, Ghaziabad, whereby compensation @ Rs.93.75 per square yard along with statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 regarding the acquired land situated in Village Yakubpur, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar has been awarded to the land owners.

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the cross objector has submitted that the land owners in similarly acquired land had filed cross objection in First Appeal No.230 of 2008 (NOIDA vs. Jai Ram Singh Bhati and others), which was allowed by this Court, vide order dated 05.03.2020, whereby the compensation awarded by the Reference Court was enhanced from Rs.93.75 per square yard to Rs.297/- per square yard along with other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
which was challenged by the NOIDA by preferring an appeal before the Apex Court, which was also dismissed vide order dated 28.11.2024, as such, the matter regarding the concerned land acquisition has attained finality.

entities.text: First Appeal No.230 of 2008 (NOIDA vs. Jai Ram Singh Bhati and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the NOIDA fairly accepted that in view of the above order pronounced by this Court the compensation @ Rs.297/- per square yard for similar acquired land situated in Village Yakubpur, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar vide notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 25.06.1988 has attained finality, because the appeal preferred by the NOIDA against the order of this Court dated 05.03.2020 has been dismissed by the Apex Court,
but learned counsel submitted that the cross objection was filed belatedly and cross objector has not made good the deficiency of Court fee for sufficiently long period, therefore, the cross objectors may not be granted interest on the enhanced amount of compensation awarded by this Court.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. It is evident that in the instant case, the land situated in Village Yakubpur, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar was acquired by notification under Section 4(1)
of the Act dated 25.06.1988.
The land was acquired for construction of houses by NOIDA.

The award of the Collector was made on 07.11.1990, whereby compensation @ Rs.36.07 paise per square yard was given to the land owners, which has been enhanced by the Reference Court to Rs.93.75 paise per square yard, along with other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

It is also apparent that the other land owners of similarly acquired land, had challenged the award of the Reference Court by filing cross objections in First Appeal No. 230 of 2008 (NOIDA New Okhla Industrial Development ... vs Virendra Singh And Others on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9944861/
2 vs. Jai Ram Singh Bhati), which was allowed by this Court vide order dated 05.03.2020 and the compensation was enhanced to Rs.297/- per square yard.

7. It is also apparent that the above order of this Court was challenged by NOIDA by filing S.L.P.
(Civil) No.14154- 14155 of 2020 (NOIDA vs. Jai Ram Singh Bhati and another), which was dismissed by the Apex Court on 28.11.2024,

sentences.text:
as such, the matter of compensation regarding acquired land situated in Village Yakubpur, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, acquired by notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 25.06.1988, has attained finality,
and in view of this, the cross objectors are also entitled to get enhanced compensation @ Rs.297/-
per square yard along with other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
8.
Accordingly, the cross objection is allowed.
The cross objectors are awarded enhanced compensation @ Rs.297/- per square yard along with other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act for their acquired land.

9. It is also apparent that the cross objectors should have immediately challenged the impugned award and decree of the Reference Court dated 13.05.2002 by filing cross objections, but the cross objections were filed with delay on 04.07.2013 and the deficiency of Court fee was made good on 02.09.2024

, as such, in the above facts and circumstances of the case, the cross objectors are not entitled to get interest on the enhanced amount of compensation awarded by this Court for the period 14.05.2002 to 02.09.2024.
10.
However, in the facts and circumstances of the case, the parties shall bear their respective costs of this appeal.
11. Office is directed to prepare the decree, accordingly.

(Sandeep Jain,J.) September 8, 2025 Jitendra  New Okhla Industrial Development ... vs Virendra Singh And Others on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9944861/
